gen-gf-paprika-gf-halant: Halant reads with a faint thick-thin shift and outward-pointing terminals, giving its tall lowercase a traditional, quietly authoritative bearing on the page. Paprika earns its keep when set big and short.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-headland-one: Big voice, careful manners: Paprika stretches its capital-sized lowercase wide across the line, with counters that breathe like a cut reed. Paprika commands the headline; Headland One handles the quiet, engraved detail.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Paprika sets its lowercase as tall as capitals, shouting across the line. Hedvig Letters Serif carries paragraphs after paragraphs smoothly, its open-ended curves and sturdy lowercase keeping the text comfortable.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-marcellus-sc: Wide, loud lettering: Paprika fills the line edge to edge. Marcellus SC steps in with gentle modulation and pulled-back terminals, its thinnest curves still carrying real weight beside the heading.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-montagu-slab: Paprika stretches its lowercase to capital height, spacing letters far apart and letting its counters breathe. Montagu Slab follows with robust downstrokes, slender turns and a sizable x-height for screen reading.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-serif-hentaigana: Noto Serif Hentaigana keeps open jaws on every curve and small letters nearly as tall as capitals, with visible modulation. Paprika, loud and widely spaced, takes the heading role.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-literata: Phudu draws every curve open with a plain ballpoint line and no thin hairline anywhere. Literata settles into extended text easily, its slightly heavier thick strokes leading the eye without dominating it.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-sentient: Pinched, closed-in apertures and slightly thinner crossbars give this body a tight, contemporary texture on the page. Sentient's tempered modulation set against Phudu's plain, never-swelling line is the standout quality here.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-literata: Literata brings sturdy thin lines and a faint thick-thin shift, with wide-mouthed curves that stay open. But long text moves smoothly in Literata, while Pixelify Sans keeps to wire-thick headings.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-sentient: Sentient reads tight and contemporary, its pinched apertures and slightly thin crossbars closing in on each letter. While Pixelify Sans spreads bold, open letters at display size, Sentient does its best work in running text.
